requirementSummary: Validate UI input for coil height ensuring values are within 1.25" to 100" and are rounded to the nearest coil‑specific increment based on tube size or coil type.
businessRules: Valid coil height range is 1.25" to 100".
The entered coil height must be a multiple of a coil‑specific increment.
If the entered value is not an exact multiple, it must be rounded to the nearest valid increment.
developerConsiderations: Implement a lookup table linking coil type/configuration to its increment value.
Create validation logic to enforce the 1.25"‑100" range.
Develop a rounding algorithm that finds the nearest multiple of the applicable increment (handle tie‑breaker consistently).
Ensure UI displays the rounded value back to the user.
Handle floating‑point precision to avoid rounding errors.
Provide error handling for unrecognized coil types or missing configuration data.
Consider unit consistency (inches) and potential future support for other units.
ambiguities: How to resolve ties when the entered value is exactly halfway between two valid increments (round up or down?).
How the system determines that a 3/8" tube uses the "1" spacing" configuration versus the default increment.
Behavior for inputs below the minimum (1.25") or above the maximum (100"); whether to show an error or clamp to range.
What should happen if a coil type not listed in the increment mapping is selected.
